caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an old metal saucepan with a long handle, placed against a plain, light beige background. The saucepan is rendered in shades of brown and copper, showing signs of wear and patina, especially visible along the rim and inner surface. There are rivets and seams connecting the handle to the main body, and traces of greenish oxidation are present around these joints and inside the end of the cylindrical handle. The body of the saucepan has a slightly irregular, dented shape with a small spout on one side. The composition centers the saucepan, and there is a small printed label that reads "FRANK MEINCE" in the lower right corner.
title: Copper Candy Ladle
